title: REQ · Closing the sheet returns focus to the Suggest What Happens Next trigger
summary: App restores focus to the trigger button when the sheet closes
description: Context: App.tsx opens the sheet from a plain button via sheetOpen state. Desired behavior: the trigger is a ref-held button and the sheet passes onCloseAutoFocus that focuses it. Expected result: after Escape or Close, document.activeElement is the trigger. Why: keyboard users keep their place.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sheet was opened from the trigger, when Escape is pressed, then the trigger has focus
Given the sheet was opened from the trigger, when Close is clicked, then the trigger has focus

preserve: Trigger text Suggest What Happens Next

technical_constraints: Optional prop so existing renders still work
